checks.description: S3 buckets must have server-side encryption configured via aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration with a rule block containing apply_server_side_encryption_by_default (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS)
checks.impact: Objects uploaded to S3 without SSE are stored in plaintext. If bucket access controls are bypassed or misconfigured, unencrypted objects are immediately readable without any additional key material
checks.resolution: Create an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resource with a rule block and apply_server_side_encryption_by_default specifying sse_algorithm (AES256 for SSE-S3 or aws:kms for SSE-KMS). Prefer aws:kms for regulated workloads
checks.errorMessage: S3 bucket does not have server-side encryption configured (requires aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration with rule.apply_server_side_encryption_by_default)
